title: HomeGuard Mold Clearance Testing Fee Schedule
content:
**Schedule — clearance testing after fungi, wet rot and bacteria remediation, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy**

A clearance testing fee is added to the mold payment on a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim according to the mold replacement-cost value, that is, the replacement-cost value recorded on the claim's repeated-seepage denial entry for the mold remediation:

| Mold replacement-cost value | Clearance testing fee |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 650.00 |
| 1500.00 or more but below 5000.00 | 350.00 |
| Below 1500.00 | None |

The fee is a flat amount in US dollars. It is added to the mold payment figure and forms part of the whole mold figure, so it counts inside the ceiling of the package's mold limit less the mold money already issued on the policy for losses with a date of loss in the 12 months before the call; the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent are taken on the final figure after it is added.

**Notes to the schedule**

1. The boundaries are inclusive at their lower figure: a value of exactly 5000.00 carries 650.00; a value of 4999.99 carries 350.00; a value of exactly 1500.00 carries 350.00; a value of 1499.99 carries no fee.
2. The value tested is the mold remediation value alone; the dwelling water damage on the same claim does not enter this schedule.

**Hypothetical illustrations**

- Mold value 6100.00: fee 650.00.
- Mold value 2750.00: fee 350.00.
- Mold value 900.00: no clearance testing fee.
- Mold value 4800.00 on a claim where the package's mold limit less the mold money already issued on the policy in the prior 12 months leaves only 5000.00 of room: the 350.00 fee is added, and the whole mold figure, fee included, is held within that 5000.00.
